rationale: The workflow builds ARMv7 Debian packages in a debian:bookworm container and fetches system dependencies via apt-get (no language package manager, no lockfile, no pip/Node/Gradle/Bazel). The measured P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE evidence is specific to pip caching keyed on pyproject.toml, which does not exist here. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE requires dependency-download state with lockfile/environment inputs and contraindicates mutable cached content; the apt package list is hardcoded in a run step (no lockfile) and the apt cache is mutable, so a safe cache key cannot be constructed and stale/mutable cached packages are a contraindication. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT requires representative successful-duration history to set a safe limit, but ci_history shows no completed runs, and a wrong timeout could terminate valid slow cross-compilation/build steps. No other pattern fits without reducing coverage or adding unrelated changes.
